tagline: Leading North American diversified financial services provider
hero_kpi_rationale: Loan book is the primary driver of net interest income, the central engine of TD's commercial and retail banking. Its growth directly reflects balance sheet expansion and market share gains in North America.

kpis.name: Loan Book
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans extended to clients, the foundation of interest income.
kpis.description: Loan book reached 695.8 billion USD in 2025, up 6.2% year-over-year, supported by residential and commercial demand.
kpis.signal: Solid loan portfolio growth in 2025, driven by the Canadian segment and U.S. retail banking.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income and interest expense, expressed as a percentage of earning assets.
kpis.description: NIM stands at 2.15% in 2025, up 12 basis points year-over-year, benefiting from rising rates and optimized balance sheet management.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement thanks to favorable interest rate positioning.

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by shareholders' equity, measures performance for shareholders.
kpis.description: Return on equity reached 14.8% in 2025, up 80 basis points, driven by margin improvement and cost discipline.
kpis.signal: ROE progressing toward strategic target of 15-17%.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Regulatory capital strength measure, essential for dividends and buybacks.
kpis.description: CET1 ratio stands at 12.7% in 2025, up 30 basis points, exceeding regulatory requirements and supporting capital return policies.
kpis.signal: High CET1 ratio, providing flexibility for capital returns.

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of costs in total revenue: lower = more efficient.
kpis.description: Cost-to-income ratio declined to 56.4% in 2025, thanks to process optimization and revenue growth.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management (Wealth)
kpis.explanation: Total assets managed for high-net-worth clients, a source of recurring revenue.
kpis.description: Assets under management in wealth management reached 489.2 billion USD in 2025, up 7.5% year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Robust growth driven by equity markets and client acquisition.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.78 USD last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders through dividends of 7.663 billion USD last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 37.3% last year.

ai_positioning.summary: TD is progressively integrating artificial intelligence into its client services and risk management, without positioning itself as a technology leader. The focus is on improving client experience and operational efficiency.
evidence: Use of AI chatbots for customer service
Predictive analytics for credit risk management
Piloting automation solutions in back-office operations
